Coram : P. SATHASIVAM*, RANJAN GOGOI
PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION ACT, 1988: A B ss. 13 (1) (d) and 13 (2) - Criminal proceedings against c appellant on the a/legation that while he was holding the office of Minister, he compelled approval of journey of four persons to London in connection with his medical treatment - Held: Record London had assisted the appellant in performing certain tasks connected 0 with the discharge of his duties as a Minister - It was for the Minister to decide on the number and identity of the officials and supporting staff to accompany him to London if it was anticipated that he would be required
Decision Date : 09-11-2012 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1804/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
